title: MUD & IRON
subtitle: Every follower is a soldier. Every day, the front decides.

factions.name: The Hegemony
factions.pitch: Order. Discipline. Iron. Stand with the Empire.

factions.name: The Concord
factions.pitch: Free men in the mud. Stand with the Alliance.

archetypes.name: Rifleman
archetypes.desc: The backbone of the line. Sentry, raids, mud.

archetypes.name: Machine Gunner
archetypes.desc: Holds the line with the gun. Feared by both sides.

archetypes.name: Sapper
archetypes.desc: Digs tunnels under no man's land. Listens to the earth.

archetypes.name: Stretcher Bearer
archetypes.desc: Carries the wounded out. Saves other players' soldiers.

archetypes.name: Runner
archetypes.desc: Carries orders under fire. Knows every trench.

archetypes.name: Sniper
archetypes.desc: Patient, alone, deadly. Duels across the wire.

archetypes.name: Signaller
archetypes.desc: Keeps the wires alive. Hears what others don't.

archetypes.name: Field Cook
archetypes.desc: Feeds the line. Everyone's friend, nobody's target.

archetypes.name: Chaplain
archetypes.desc: Buries the dead, writes the letters, keeps faith.

milestones.text: A thousand souls in the mud. The generals take notice.
The front grows. New sectors are dug.
Steel monsters arrive from the rear: the first tanks.

dm.enlisted: {rank} @{handle}, you have been assigned to {unit}, sector {sector}. Find yourself on the front: {url}
dm.claim: Your claim code: {code}. Comment it under our latest post to take command of your soldier.

lore.tagline: The Great War ended. Here, it never did.
lore.short: For six winters the Concord and the Hegemony have bled into the same valley of mud. Neither will yield. Both need men. They need you.
lore.concord: The Concord: a ragged alliance of free provinces in khaki and flat steel helmets. They fight for the right to go home. Together, or not at all.
lore.hegemony: The Hegemony: an iron empire in field grey that does not know the word retreat. Order, discipline, the long patience of steel. Iron endures.

hegemony: Welcome to the front, {rank} @{handle}. Your post: sector {sector}. Iron endures 🩶 Find yourself via the link in bio.
@{handle} The Hegemony grows stronger. Report to sector {sector}, soldier 🩶
concord: Welcome to the front, {rank} @{handle}. Your post: sector {sector}. Together, or not at all 🫒 Find yourself via the link in bio.
@{handle} Another hand for the Concord. Report to sector {sector} 🫒

race.reward: Holds the high ground: 3 days of artillery on the enemy, a safer week for its soldiers, a ribbon for everyone on the winning side, and the title of hero for the soldier who tips the balance.

schedule._note: Denní rytmus v UTC (pevně, bez letního času). editionUtc = nový den války: denní tah, nové číslo novin, vyhodnocení hlasování. reelUtc = večerní reel/příspěvek (fronta marketing/queue.json).

valley._note: Výpravy (docs/MAP_MISSIONS.md). Každé `every` dny ranní noviny vyhlásí výpravu, přihlášky do dalšího vydání, `slots` míst na frakci. Místo: x,y v mřížce mapy 192×120, img v web/public/assets/locations (size = velikost v buňkách; bez obrázku se nakreslí náhradní ikona). perk: observe|morale|supplies|intel|crossing|cover|hospital|tunnels; demolition = ženista +3 útok.

abilities.suppress: Suppression: hits two targets; the enemy loses 1 attack in the first round. May jam in the rain.
abilities.demolition: Demolition: +3 attack at the church, the brickworks and the quarry.
abilities.firstshot: First shot before the fight begins. Half attack in fog, +2 in clear weather.
abilities.heal: Patches up the worst wounded every round (+3) and saves one comrade from death.
abilities.initiative: Moves first. If the raid fails, gets everyone out: nobody is taken prisoner.
abilities.artillery: Calls one shell (5 damage) if the side holds the church or the outpost, or the sky is clear.
abilities.morale: Hot food: everyone else in the squad gets +1 attack and +1 defence.
abilities.faith: The squad never breaks and runs. Everyone starts with +2 health.
abilities.command: Orders: +1 attack for the whole squad in the first exchange. Goes for the weakest enemy.

ok: @{handle} You are on the list for {loc}. {n}/{slots} {us} volunteers so far. Results in the morning Gazette.
@{handle} Noted, soldier. {loc}, tonight. Blacken your face. ({n}/{slots} {us})
full: @{handle} The {us} squad for {loc} is full ({slots}/{slots}). Next raid in a few days.
notActive: @{handle} Your soldier is not on the line right now, so the sergeant cannot take you on this raid.
notEnlisted: @{handle} Only soldiers can volunteer. Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD first to enlist, then {kw} again to join the raid on {loc}.

locations.name: Ruined Church of Saint-Ash
locations.desc: A shelled church with half a bell tower. The only high point in the valley.
locations.perkText: The tower sees for miles: signallers of the side that holds it can call down artillery on every raid.

locations.name: The Cemetery
locations.desc: Graves torn open by shells behind the church. Both sides bury their dead here at night.
locations.perkText: Morale: fewer losses on the line while under bombardment.

locations.name: Ruins of Verdel
locations.desc: What is left of the town of Verdel: cellars, chimneys and one stubborn bakery oven.
locations.perkText: Supplies from the cellars: fewer wounded on the line every day.

locations.name: Lonely Observation Post
locations.desc: A sandbagged hole far out in no man's land with a periscope and a field telephone.
locations.perkText: Intelligence: the side that holds it moves first on every raid, and its signallers can call artillery.

locations.name: Grey Mill
locations.desc: A stone mill by the canal. The only bridge left standing.
locations.perkText: The canal road: raiders arrive rested, +2 health for everyone on every raid.

locations.name: The Brickworks
locations.desc: Kilns and a tall chimney. Walls thick enough to stop a shell.
locations.perkText: Cover: the front line of the side that holds it is safer.

locations.name: Field Hospital at Calvary Farm
locations.desc: A farmhouse with red crosses painted on the roof. Not everyone respects them.
locations.perkText: The wounded of the side that holds it recover faster.

locations.name: The Bone Quarry
locations.desc: A chalk quarry full of old tunnels. Some say they run under both lines.
locations.perkText: Tunnels: sappers of the side that holds it get +2 attack on every raid.

battle._note: Denní boj, medici, nemocnice a drát (engine/battle.js, docs/BATTLE.md). Stavby jen hlasováním frakce (možnost hlasování s build: id). Každá nemocnice (dugout) má 4 lůžka, další se staví jen hlasováním. Bombardování (shell) dopadá na 2 sektory poraženého denně.

dugout.done: dug a hospital dugout behind the line: 4 beds

sandbags.name: Sandbag parapets
sandbags.done: raised the parapets with fresh sandbags: fewer men hit
